verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents Gusto's Embedded Payroll API (aimed at partners building payroll into their own platforms) plus general community sentiment about payroll/support quality. There is no evidence describing a self-serve new-hire onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one — only tangential mentions of company-level bank setup and a generic note that employees must provide federal tax info, with no mention of I-9 at all.
